craft_notes: Sthāyin: completion-verse (twelvefold sealed → Śiva). Sanskrit: kramadvādaśakaṃ...muktvāntataḥ śivaḥ → L4 keeps freed-twice emphasis (having freed, having freed at end — L3 kept double; L4 too: the double IS music). Rows: row 3 (freed→Śiva). Close: Śiva (the block's first fruit-word). Rejected: 'liberated' — killed: freed kept; dropping the doubled 'freed' — killed: repetition is the cadence.

lines: Twelvefold course rightly, twelve letters divided;
through gross, subtle, supreme: freed at end — Śiva.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kramadvādaśakaṃ samyag dvādaśākṣarabheditam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā muktvā muktvāntataḥ śivaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is the course? → Passing through gross-subtle-supreme standing, freed at end one is Śiva.
c1_essence: Twelve-letter course through gross-subtle-supreme: freed, Śiva.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
